function textDelay(c, items): number;

Defined in: website/views/project/layout.ts:49

Per-char draw delay for a section's text run: counts REAL characters (HTML stripped — tags don't consume stagger time), then sizes the interval so the whole run lands inside DRAW_TARGET_MS. Non-array input gets the fallback delay so malformed CMS data still animates.
